note: Project record of every external coordinate, geodata and route-figure source used by the M2 world-travel and world-map data. It is not legal advice. Entries with licenseStatus 'needs-replacement-or-verification' block packaging until resolved. The same travel sources are mirrored in the travel data under attribution.sources; the validation test keeps both in step.

Obtain authorisation, replace with a source of known terms, or get a reviewed determination before packaging.
